record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Find formulas, or at least sharp upper bounds, for the regularity of an edge monomial ideal in terms of properties of its defining graph.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G = (V, E)$ be a finite simple graph with vertex set $V = \{x_1, \dots, x_n\}$, and let $k$ be a field. The edge ideal of $G$ is the squarefree monomial ideal
$$I(G) = (x_i x_j : \{x_i, x_j\} \in E) \subseteq S = k[x_1, \dots, x_n].$$
The Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity of $I(G)$ is defined as
$$\operatorname{reg}(I(G)) = \max\{ j - i : \beta_{i,j}(S/I(G)) \neq 0 \},$$
where $\beta_{i,j}$ are the graded Betti numbers of $S/I(G)$ over $S$.

Problem: Determine a closed-form formula, or at least a sharp upper bound, for $\operatorname{reg}(I(G))$ expressed purely in terms of combinatorial invariants of $G$ (such as the matching number, induced matching number, independence number, chromatic invariants, or forbidden induced subgraph data), that is valid for every finite simple graph $G$.
artifact.status_search_result: Determining the regularity of edge ideals from combinatorial data of the underlying graph remains an active and largely open research area. While many partial results are known (e.g., Fröberg's theorem characterizing linear resolutions, Hà–Van Tuyl's lower bound by the induced matching number, sharp bounds for specific classes such as chordal graphs, bipartite graphs, and lobsters, and recent work on powers of edge ideals), no general formula or sharp universal upper bound in terms of graph invariants is currently known for arbitrary graphs.

status_evidence.title: Upper bounds for the regularity of powers of edge ideals of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: New upper bounds on the regularity of powers of edge ideals are obtained for graphs whose complement does not have any induced four cycles.
status_evidence.claim: Research continues to produce new partial bounds, indicating the general problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Regularity of powers of edge ideals: from local properties to global bounds
status_evidence.snippet: Bounds for the regularity function of powers of edge ideals; addresses conjectures rather than providing a closed-form solution.
status_evidence.claim: General sharp bounds for regularity of edge ideals are still being conjectured and investigated.

status_evidence.title: Bounds on the regularity and projective dimension of ideals associated to graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Survey-style bounds on regularity in terms of graph-theoretic data.
status_evidence.claim: Bounds are known in special cases but no universal formula exists.
